text:
The Studienstiftung des deutschen Volkes, initially founded in Dresden in 1925 as part of the Deutsche Studentenschaft, was dissolved in 1934 under National Socialism, being replaced by the "Reichsförderung." It was subsequently reformed as a registered association in Cologne in 1948.
The organization's mission is founded upon the principles of "excellence, initiative and responsibility." It provides a general scholarship for full-time bachelor's and master's studies, offering both financial and academic support. Eligibility is determined through various channels, including nomination by schools, professors, or examination boards; winners of national or federal competitions; and through an assessment test since February 2010. The Studienstiftung also supports doctoral candidates.
